flags.why: “Nhìn tuồng mặt nó” is unnatural for this sense, which occurs in constructions such as “xem tuồng” ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-tu%E1%BB%93ng)).
flags.fix: Xem tuồng mọi việc đã ổn. = It looks as though everything has been settled.

flags.why: The entry omits the common meaning “to kiss” ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-hun)).
flags.fix: Add first: verb [colloquial, Central, Southern] | to kiss; ex: Bé hun má mẹ. = The child kisses Mum's cheek.

flags.why: “Chuyển mạch” means switching generally, including packet switching, whereas circuit switching is “chuyển mạch kênh” ([university teaching material](https://kcntt.duytan.edu.vn/bai-viet-suu-tam/mang-may-tinh-va-mang-internet)).

“Chuyển mạch” does not itself specify circuit switching rather than another form of switching ([university teaching material](https://kcntt.duytan.edu.vn/bai-viet-suu-tam/mang-may-tinh-va-mang-internet)).
“Chuyển mạch” has no meaning “transitional” or “temporary,” so the example teaches a nonexistent usage.
flags.fix: Delete this sense and its example.

flags.why: The entry omits the common use referring to donations to temples and other religious sites ([source](https://thuvienphapluat.vn/hoi-dap-phap-luat/tien-cong-duc-la-gi-tien-cong-duc-duoc-quan-ly-nhu-the-nao-138016745.html)).
flags.fix: Add: verb | to donate to a temple or other religious site; ex: Bà công đức một triệu đồng cho chùa. = She donated one million dong to the pagoda.
